apps.localizedDescription:
Open-source SEGA console emulator developed for iOS.

Supported Systems:
• SEGA Genesis / Mega Drive
• SEGA CD / Mega-CD (requires BIOS files)
• SEGA 32X
• SEGA Master System
• SEGA Game Gear

Features:
• PicoDrive (Libretro) and in-house YD-Core emulation cores
• Metal-based rendering
• Modern SwiftUI and Liquid Glass interface
• Full multi-language localization (7 languages)
• On-screen touch controls and physical controller support
• Save states and screenshots
• Automatic cover art and game info via TheGamesDB

YDrive does not contain any game ROMs or BIOS files; you must provide your own legally obtained copies.

Source code: https://github.com/yigit4451/YDrive-Emulator

news.title: Introducing YD-Core (Experimental Core)
news.caption:
We are proud to introduce YD-Core v1.2.0 — YDrive's in-house SEGA Mega Drive / Genesis emulation core written in pure C with Libretro API compatibility.

Key Highlights:
• Standalone In-House Core: High-fidelity Motorola 68000 and Zilog Z80 emulation.
• Dual-Chip Sound Engine: Yamaha YM2612 FM synthesis + SN76489 PSG with authentic discrete hardware output.
• Hardware Acceleration: Direct Memory Access (DMA) transfer acceleration.
• Ultra-Low Latency: Zero external dependencies, integrated directly into YDrive.
• YDSS v2 State Engine: Robust state management with FNV-1a checksum validation.

YD-Core can be enabled inside YDrive under Settings > Experimental.

news.title: YDrive 1.0.3 Update
news.caption:
YDrive 1.0.3 is now available with full internationalization, refined save management, and enhanced user experience!

• Multi-Language Localization: Complete support for 7 languages — English, Turkish, German, Spanish, Japanese, Arabic (with RTL layout support), and Russian.
• System Language Settings: Integrated with iOS Per-App Language settings in Apple Settings app.
• Liquid Glass Save Cards: Save states redesigned with native Apple Liquid Glass, single-tap instant load, and leading alignment in landscape mode.
• Screenshot Toast Notification: Smooth top-to-bottom animated blue notification banner confirming screenshots are saved to Photos.
• Streamlined Experimental Settings: Enabling experimental features now automatically switches to the in-house YD-Core engine.
• Refined Confirmation Dialogs: Simplified and translated deletion and restart prompts.

news.title: YDrive 1.0.2 Update
news.caption:
⚠️NOTE: The sharing feature only uses the native iOS Share Sheet. The app does not include or host any ROMs in any way.

YDrive 1.0.2 is now available!

• SEGA Game Gear Support: Full emulation support added for SEGA Game Gear titles.
• Grid & List Layouts: Switch between card grid and compact list views directly in the home library.
• ROM Sharing: Export and share selected games as .zip archives using the native iOS share sheet.
• Touch Input Fix: Resolved an input timing issue where button presses were triggering on touch release instead of touch down.
• Duplicate ROMs Fix: Resolved an issue where adding ROMs could cause duplicate entries in the game library.
• UI Refinements: Streamlined the Details view and moved metadata refresh into the ROM context menu.
